headline: VMS TMT suspends Bavla operations after furnace breakdown
summary: VMS TMT Ltd reported a furnace breakdown at its Bavla facility on October 30, 2026. Operations are temporarily suspended with no injuries reported.

headline: EFC (I) Ltd Q2FY27 Results
summary: EFC (I) Ltd reported a qualified audit opinion on Q2FY27 results due to unbilled revenue and receivables. Consolidated PAT rose to ₹7,726 lakh.
